import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import jsonlines
from tqdm import tqdm

BATCH_SIZE = 64
EPOCHS = 30
LR = 0.001
SEQ_LEN = 107
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
EPSILON = 1e-6


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_items, mode="train"):
        self.mode = mode
        self.ids = [item["id"] for item in data_items]
        self.seqs = [list(item["sequence"]) for item in data_items]
        self.structs = [list(item["structure"]) for item in data_items]
        self.loops = [list(item["predicted_loop_type"]) for item in data_items]

        if mode != "test":
            self.targets = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity"],
                        item["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        item["deg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]
            self.errors = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity_error"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]

        self.nuc_map = {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3}
        self.struct_map = {".": 0, "(": 1, ")": 2}
        self.loop_map = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        seq = torch.tensor([self.nuc_map[s] for s in self.seqs[idx]])
        struct = torch.tensor([self.struct_map[s] for s in self.structs[idx]])
        loop = torch.tensor([self.loop_map[l] for l in self.loops[idx]])
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ_LEN)

        if self.mode == "test":
            return self.ids[idx], seq, struct, loop, pos

        target = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        errors = torch.FloatTensor(self.errors[idx])
        return seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors


class MultiScaleConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),  # Fixed input channels
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.conv5 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=5, padding=2),  # Fixed input channels
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.conv7 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=7, padding=3),  # Fixed input channels
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.depthwise = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(384, 384, kernel_size=5, padding=2, groups=384),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(384, 256, kernel_size=1),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        c3 = self.conv3(x)
        c5 = self.conv5(x)
        c7 = self.conv7(x)
        x = torch.cat([c3, c5, c7], dim=1)
        return self.depthwise(x).permute(0, 2, 1)


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, 64)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 32)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, 32)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(SEQ_LEN, 96)

        self.conv_block = MultiScaleConv()

        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            256, 512, num_layers=3, bidirectional=True, dropout=0.3, batch_first=True
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(1024, 8, 2048, dropout=0.2, activation="gelu"),
            num_layers=4,
        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 5),
        )

        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for name, p in self.named_parameters():
            if "weight" in name:
                if "lstm" in name:
                    nn.init.orthogonal_(p)
                elif "transformer" in name:
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(p)
                elif "conv" in name:
                    nn.init.kaiming_normal_(p, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="gelu")
                elif "emb" in name:
                    nn.init.normal_(p, mean=0.0, std=0.02)
            elif "bias" in name:
                nn.init.constant_(p, 0.0)

    def forward(self, seq, struct, loop, pos):
        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(seq)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        pos_emb = self.pos_emb(pos)

        x = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb, pos_emb], dim=-1)
        x = self.conv_block(x)
        x, _ = self.lstm(x)
        x = self.transformer(x.permute(1, 0, 2))
        return self.head(x.permute(1, 0, 2))


def mcrmse_loss(preds, targets, errors):
    squared_errors = (preds - targets) ** 2
    weighted_errors = squared_errors / (errors**2 + EPSILON)
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_errors, dim=[0, 1]))
    return torch.mean(rmse_per_target)


# Data loading
with jsonlines.open("input/train.jsonl") as f:
    train_data = [item for item in f if item["SN_filter"]]
train_data, val_data = train_test_split(train_data, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

train_ds = RNADataset(train_data)
val_ds = RNADataset(val_data)

train_loader = DataLoader(

val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=6, pin_memory=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=6, pin_memory=True)

# Training setup
model = RNAModel().to(DEVICE)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=0.1)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
    optimizer, max_lr=LR, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader), epochs=EPOCHS
)
best_val = float("inf")

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):

    for batch in progress:
        seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors = [x.to(DEVICE) for x in batch]
        pred = model(seq, struct, loop, pos)
        loss = mcrmse_loss(pred[:, :68, :3], target[:, :, :3], errors)

        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

        progress.set_postfix({"loss": loss.item()})

    # Validation

    avg_val = np.mean(val_loss)
    if avg_val < best_val:

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val MCRMSE: {avg_val:.4f}")

# Generate submission

loop_type_to_idx = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.features = []
        self.targets = [] if not is_test else None
        self.weights = [] if not is_test else None

        for idx in range(len(self.df)):
            row = self.df.iloc[idx]
            seq = row["sequence"]
            struct = row["structure"]
            loop_type = row["predicted_loop_type"]
            sample_features = []

            pair_map = {}
            stack = []
            for i, c in enumerate(struct):
                if c == "(":
                    stack.append(i)
                elif c == ")":
                    if stack:
                        j = stack.pop()
                        pair_map[i] = j
                        pair_map[j] = i

            for i in range(len(seq)):
                nuc_oh = np.eye(4, dtype=np.float32)[nuc_to_idx[seq[i]]]
                struct_oh = np.eye(3, dtype=np.float32)[struct_to_idx[struct[i]]]
                loop_oh = np.eye(7, dtype=np.float32)[loop_type_to_idx[loop_type[i]]]

                pair_dist = 0.0
                if i in pair_map:
                    pair_dist = np.abs(i - pair_map[i]) / 107.0
                struct_feat = np.array([pair_dist], dtype=np.float32)

                feature = np.concatenate([nuc_oh, struct_oh, loop_oh, struct_feat])
                sample_features.append(feature)

            self.features.append(np.array(sample_features))

            if not self.is_test:
                targets = np.stack(
                    [
                        row["reactivity"],
                        row["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        row["deg_pH10"],
                        row["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        row["deg_50C"],
                    ],
                    axis=1,
                ).astype(np.float32)
                self.targets.append(targets)

                errors = np.stack(
                    [
                        row["error_reactivity"],
                        row["error_deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        row["error_deg_pH10"],
                        row["error_deg_Mg_50C"],
                        row["error_deg_50C"],
                    ],
                    axis=1,
                )
                weights = 1.0 / (errors**2 + 1e-6)
                self.weights.append(weights[:, [0, 1, 3]])

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        x = torch.tensor(self.features[idx], dtype=torch.float32)
        if self.is_test:
            return (x, torch.zeros(0))
        else:
            y = torch.tensor(self.targets[idx])
            w = torch.tensor(self.weights[idx])
            return x, y, w


class DepthwiseConv1d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim, kernel_size, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(
            dim, 2 * dim, kernel_size, padding=kernel_size // 2, groups=dim
        )
        self.glu = nn.GLU(dim=1)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(dim)
        self.silu = nn.SiLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(
            dim, dim, kernel_size, padding=kernel_size // 2, groups=dim
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        x = self.conv1(x)
        x = self.glu(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        x = self.silu(x)
        x = self.conv2(x)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        return x.permute(0, 2, 1)


class ConformerBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim, n_heads, conv_kernel=31, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.ff1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.LayerNorm(dim),
            nn.Linear(dim, 4 * dim),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(4 * dim, dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            dim, n_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.conv = DepthwiseConv1d(dim, conv_kernel, dropout)
        self.ff2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.LayerNorm(dim),
            nn.Linear(dim, 4 * dim),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(4 * dim, dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.ff1(x)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(x, x, x)
        x = x + attn_out
        x = x + self.conv(x)
        x = x + self.ff2(x)
        return self.norm(x)


class ConformerModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, input_dim=15, pos_dim=8, dim=256, n_heads=4, n_layers=6, conv_kernel=31
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.pos_embed = nn.Embedding(107, pos_dim)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(input_dim + pos_dim, dim)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList(
            [ConformerBlock(dim, n_heads, conv_kernel) for _ in range(n_layers)]
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(dim, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(128, 5),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        batch_size, seq_len = x.shape[:2]
        pos = torch.arange(seq_len, device=x.device).unsqueeze(0)
        x = torch.cat([x, self.pos_embed(pos).expand(batch_size, -1, -1)], dim=2)
        x = self.proj(x)
        for block in self.blocks:
            x = block(x)
        return self.head(x)

import os
import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split


def read_jsonl(path):
    return pd.DataFrame([json.loads(line) for line in open(path)])


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.maps = {
            "nuc": {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3},
            "struct": {"(": 0, ")": 1, ".": 2},
            "loop": {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6},
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample = self.df.iloc[idx]
        seq = [self.maps["nuc"][c] for c in sample["sequence"]]
        struct = [self.maps["struct"][c] for c in sample["structure"]]
        loop = [self.maps["loop"][c] for c in sample["predicted_loop_type"]]

        features = (
            torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(struct, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(loop, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.arange(107, dtype=torch.long),
        )

        if self.is_test:
            return *features, sample["id"]

        targets = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        # Corrected target column order
        error_cols = ["reactivity", "deg_pH10", "deg_Mg_pH10", "deg_50C", "deg_Mg_50C"]
        for i, col in enumerate(error_cols):
            targets[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        errors = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        # Corrected error column order
        error_names = [
            "reactivity_error",
            "deg_pH10_error",
            "deg_Mg_pH10_error",
            "deg_50C_error",
            "deg_Mg_50C_error",
        ]
        for i, col in enumerate(error_names):
            errors[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        return *features, targets, errors


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleDict(
            {
                "nuc": nn.Embedding(4, 16),
                "struct": nn.Embedding(3, 8),
                "loop": nn.Embedding(7, 12),
                "pos": nn.Embedding(107, 12),
            }
        )

        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(48, 128, 5, padding=2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(128, 8, 512, activation="gelu", dropout=0.1),
            num_layers=6,
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(128, 5)

    def forward(self, nuc, struct, loop, pos):
        embs = [
            self.embeddings["nuc"](nuc),
            self.embeddings["struct"](struct),
            self.embeddings["loop"](loop),
            self.embeddings["pos"](pos),
        ]
        x = torch.cat(embs, dim=-1).permute(0, 2, 1)
        x = self.conv(x).permute(2, 0, 1)
        x = self.transformer(x).permute(1, 0, 2)
        return self.out(x)


def calculate_loss(preds, targets, errors):
    eps = 1e-6
    # Scored targets: reactivity, deg_Mg_pH10, deg_Mg_50C (cols 0,2,3)
    scored_preds = preds[:, :68, [0, 2, 3]]
    scored_tgts = targets[:, :, [0, 2, 3]]
    scored_errs = errors[:, :, [0, 2, 3]]
    sq_err = (scored_preds - scored_tgts) ** 2
    weighted_sq_err = sq_err / (scored_errs**2 + eps)
    mcrmse = torch.mean(torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_sq_err, dim=1)))

    # Unscored targets: deg_pH10, deg_50C (cols 1,4)
    unscored_preds = preds[:, :68, [1, 4]]

    sq_err_unscored = (unscored_preds - unscored_tgts) ** 2
    weighted_unscored = sq_err_unscored / (unscored_errs**2 + eps)
    mse = torch.mean(weighted_unscored)

    return mcrmse + 0.2 * mse

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import jsonlines
from tqdm import tqdm

BATCH_SIZE = 64
EPOCHS = 30
LR = 0.001
SEQ_LEN = 107
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
EPSILON = 1e-6


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_items, mode="train"):
        self.mode = mode
        self.ids = [item["id"] for item in data_items]
        self.seqs = [list(item["sequence"]) for item in data_items]
        self.structs = [list(item["structure"]) for item in data_items]
        self.loops = [list(item["predicted_loop_type"]) for item in data_items]

        if mode != "test":
            self.targets = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity"],
                        item["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        item["deg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]
            self.errors = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity_error"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]

        self.nuc_map = {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3}
        self.struct_map = {".": 0, "(": 1, ")": 2}
        self.loop_map = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        seq = torch.tensor([self.nuc_map[s] for s in self.seqs[idx]])
        struct = torch.tensor([self.struct_map[s] for s in self.structs[idx]])
        loop = torch.tensor([self.loop_map[l] for l in self.loops[idx]])
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ_LEN)

        if self.mode == "test":
            return self.ids[idx], seq, struct, loop, pos

        target = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        errors = torch.FloatTensor(self.errors[idx])
        return seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors


class MultiScaleConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.conv5 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=5, padding=2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.conv7 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=7, padding=3),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.depthwise = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(384, 384, kernel_size=5, padding=2, groups=384),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(384, 256, kernel_size=1),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        c3 = self.conv3(x)
        c5 = self.conv5(x)
        c7 = self.conv7(x)
        x = torch.cat([c3, c5, c7], dim=1)
        return self.depthwise(x).permute(0, 2, 1)


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, 64)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 32)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, 32)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(SEQ_LEN, 96)

        self.conv_block = MultiScaleConv()
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            256, 512, num_layers=3, bidirectional=True, dropout=0.3, batch_first=True
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(1024, 8, 2048, dropout=0.2, activation="gelu"),
            num_layers=4,
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 5),
        )
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for name, p in self.named_parameters():
            if "weight" in name:
                if "lstm" in name:
                    nn.init.orthogonal_(p)
                elif "transformer" in name:
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(p)
                elif "conv" in name:
                    nn.init.kaiming_normal_(
                        p, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="relu"
                    )  # Fixed initialization
                elif "emb" in name:
                    nn.init.normal_(p, mean=0.0, std=0.02)
            elif "bias" in name:
                nn.init.constant_(p, 0.0)

    def forward(self, seq, struct, loop, pos):
        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(seq)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        pos_emb = self.pos_emb(pos)

        x = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb, pos_emb], dim=-1)
        x = self.conv_block(x)
        x, _ = self.lstm(x)
        x = self.transformer(x.permute(1, 0, 2))
        return self.head(x.permute(1, 0, 2))


def mcrmse_loss(preds, targets, errors):
    squared_errors = (preds - targets) ** 2
    weighted_errors = squared_errors / (errors**2 + EPSILON)
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_errors, dim=[0, 1]))
    return torch.mean(rmse_per_target)


# Data loading
with jsonlines.open("input/train.jsonl") as f:

train_data, val_data = train_test_split(train_data, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

train_ds = RNADataset(train_data)

train_loader = DataLoader(

test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=6, pin_memory=True)

# Training setup
model = RNAModel().to(DEVICE)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=0.1)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
    optimizer, max_lr=LR, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader), epochs=EPOCHS
)
best_val = float("inf")

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):

    for batch in progress:
        seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors = [x.to(DEVICE) for x in batch]
        pred = model(seq, struct, loop, pos)
        loss = mcrmse_loss(pred[:, :68, :3], target[:, :, :3], errors)

        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()
        progress.set_postfix({"loss": loss.item()})

    # Validation
    model.eval()

        for batch in val_loader:
            seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors = [x.to(DEVICE) for x in batch]
            pred = model(seq, struct, loop, pos)
            val_loss.append(

            )

    avg_val = np.mean(val_loss)
    if avg_val < best_val:
        best_val = avg_val
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pt")
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val MCRMSE: {avg_val:.4f}")

class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.maps = {
            "nuc": {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3},
            "struct": {"(": 0, ")": 1, ".": 2},
            "loop": {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6},
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample = self.df.iloc[idx]
        seq = [self.maps["nuc"][c] for c in sample["sequence"]]
        struct = [self.maps["struct"][c] for c in sample["structure"]]
        loop = [self.maps["loop"][c] for c in sample["predicted_loop_type"]]

        features = (
            torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(struct, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(loop, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.arange(107, dtype=torch.long),
        )

        # Correct target columns
        targets = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        target_cols = ["reactivity", "deg_pH10", "deg_Mg_pH10", "deg_50C", "deg_Mg_50C"]
        for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
            targets[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        # Correct error columns
        errors = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        error_cols = [
            "reactivity_error",
            "deg_error_pH10",
            "deg_error_Mg_pH10",
            "deg_error_50C",
            "deg_error_Mg_50C",
        ]
        for i, col in enumerate(error_cols):
            errors[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        return *features, targets, errors


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleDict(
            {
                "nuc": nn.Embedding(4, 16),
                "struct": nn.Embedding(3, 8),
                "loop": nn.Embedding(7, 12),
                "pos": nn.Embedding(107, 12),
            }
        )

        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(48, 128, 5, padding=2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(128, 8, 512, activation="gelu", dropout=0.1),
            num_layers=6,
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(128, 5)

    def forward(self, nuc, struct, loop, pos):
        embs = [
            self.embeddings["nuc"](nuc),
            self.embeddings["struct"](struct),
            self.embeddings["loop"](loop),
            self.embeddings["pos"](pos),
        ]
        x = torch.cat(embs, dim=-1).permute(0, 2, 1)
        x = self.conv(x).permute(2, 0, 1)
        x = self.transformer(x).permute(1, 0, 2)
        return self.out(x)


def calculate_loss(preds, targets, errors):
    eps = 1e-6
    scored_preds = preds[:, :68, [0, 2, 3]]
    scored_tgts = targets[:, :, [0, 2, 3]]
    scored_errs = errors[:, :, [0, 2, 3]]
    sq_err = (scored_preds - scored_tgts) ** 2
    weighted_sq_err = sq_err / (scored_errs**2 + eps)
    mcrmse = torch.mean(torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_sq_err, dim=1)))

    unscored_preds = preds[:, :68, [1, 4]]
    unscored_tgts = targets[:, :, [1, 4]]
    unscored_errs = errors[:, :, [1, 4]]
    sq_err_unscored = (unscored_preds - unscored_tgts) ** 2
    weighted_unscored = sq_err_unscored / (unscored_errs**2 + eps)
    mse = torch.mean(weighted_unscored)

    return mcrmse + 0.2 * mse

        loss = calculate_loss(preds, tgt, errs)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * nuc.size(0)

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0
    with torch.no_grad():

            preds = model(nuc, struct, loop, pos)

    train_loss /= len(train_data)
    val_loss /= len(val_data)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Train {train_loss:.4f} | Val {val_loss:.4f}")

    if val_loss < best_val:

import os
import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split


def read_jsonl(path):
    return pd.DataFrame([json.loads(line) for line in open(path)])


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.maps = {
            "nuc": {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3},
            "struct": {"(": 0, ")": 1, ".": 2},
            "loop": {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6},
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample = self.df.iloc[idx]
        seq = [self.maps["nuc"][c] for c in sample["sequence"]]
        struct = [self.maps["struct"][c] for c in sample["structure"]]
        loop = [self.maps["loop"][c] for c in sample["predicted_loop_type"]]

        features = (
            torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(struct, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(loop, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.arange(107, dtype=torch.long),
        )

        if self.is_test:
            return *features, sample["id"]

        targets = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        target_cols = ["reactivity", "deg_pH10", "deg_Mg_pH10", "deg_50C", "deg_Mg_50C"]
        for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
            targets[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        errors = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        error_cols = [
            "reactivity_error",
            "deg_error_pH10",
            "deg_error_Mg_pH10",
            "deg_error_50C",
            "deg_error_Mg_50C",
        ]
        for i, col in enumerate(error_cols):
            errors[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        return *features, targets, errors


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleDict(
            {
                "nuc": nn.Embedding(4, 32),
                "struct": nn.Embedding(3, 16),
                "loop": nn.Embedding(7, 24),
                "pos": nn.Embedding(107, 24),
            }
        )

        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(96, 256, 5, padding=2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(256, 256, bidirectional=True, num_layers=2, dropout=0.2)
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(512, 8, 1024, activation="gelu", dropout=0.1),
            num_layers=8,
        )

        self.out = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, 5),
        )

    def forward(self, nuc, struct, loop, pos):
        embs = [
            self.embeddings["nuc"](nuc),
            self.embeddings["struct"](struct),
            self.embeddings["loop"](loop),
            self.embeddings["pos"](pos),
        ]
        x = torch.cat(embs, dim=-1).permute(0, 2, 1)
        x = self.conv(x).permute(2, 0, 1)

        lstm_out, _ = self.lstm(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, lstm_out], dim=-1)

        x = self.transformer(x).permute(1, 0, 2)
        return self.out(x)


def calculate_loss(preds, targets, errors):
    eps = 1e-6
    scored_preds = preds[:, :68, [0, 2, 3]]
    scored_tgts = targets[:, :, [0, 2, 3]]
    scored_errs = errors[:, :, [0, 2, 3]]
    sq_err = (scored_preds - scored_tgts) ** 2
    weighted_sq_err = sq_err / (scored_errs**2 + eps)
    mcrmse = torch.mean(torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_sq_err, dim=1)))

    return mcrmse


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
train_df = read_jsonl("input/train.jsonl")
train_data, val_data = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(val_data), batch_size=128, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
)

model = RNAModel().to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=0.05)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
    optimizer, max_lr=1e-3, epochs=35, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader)
)

best_val = float("inf")
for epoch in range(35):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        nuc, struct, loop, pos, tgt, errs = [x.to(device) for x in batch]
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        preds = model(nuc, struct, loop, pos)
        loss = calculate_loss(preds, tgt, errs)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * nuc.size(0)

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            nuc, struct, loop, pos, tgt, errs = [x.to(device) for x in batch]
            preds = model(nuc, struct, loop, pos)
            val_loss += calculate_loss(preds, tgt, errs).item() * nuc.size(0)

    train_loss /= len(train_data)
    val_loss /= len(val_data)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Train {train_loss:.4f} | Val {val_loss:.4f}")

    if val_loss < best_val:
        best_val = val_loss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

# Generate submission
test_df = read_jsonl("input/test.jsonl")
test_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(test_df, is_test=True), batch_size=128, num_workers=8

struct_to_idx = {"(": 0, ".": 1, ")": 2}
loop_type_to_idx = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.features = []
        self.targets = [] if not is_test else None

        for idx in range(len(self.df)):
            row = self.df.iloc[idx]

            struct_emb = np.array([struct_to_idx[c] for c in struct], dtype=np.int64)
            loop_emb = np.array(
                [loop_type_to_idx[c] for c in loop_type], dtype=np.int64
            )
            features = np.stack([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb], axis=1)
            self.features.append(features)

            if not self.is_test:

                    [
                        row["reactivity"],
                        row["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        row["deg_pH10"],
                        row["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        row["deg_50C"],
                    ],
                    axis=1,
                ).astype(np.float32)
                self.targets.append(targets)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        x = torch.tensor(self.features[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return (
            (x, torch.zeros(0))
            if self.is_test
            else (x, torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float32))
        )


class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, max_len=107):
        super().__init__()
        position = torch.arange(max_len).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = torch.exp(torch.arange(0, d_model, 2) * (-np.log(10000.0) / d_model))
        pe = torch.zeros(1, max_len, d_model)
        pe[0, :, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[0, :, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe)

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, : x.size(1)]


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64, nhead=8, num_layers=4, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, embed_dim)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, embed_dim)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, embed_dim)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(embed_dim * 3)

        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=embed_dim * 3, nhead=nhead, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(embed_dim * 3, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 5),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        nuc, struct, loop = x[:, :, 0], x[:, :, 1], x[:, :, 2]
        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(nuc)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        combined = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb], dim=2)
        encoded = self.pos_encoder(combined)
        encoded = self.transformer(encoded)
        return self.fc(encoded)


def mcrmse_loss(pred, target):
    squared_errors = (pred - target) ** 2
    mean_squared_errors = torch.mean(squared_errors, dim=(0, 1))
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(mean_squared_errors)
    return torch.mean(rmse_per_target)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import jsonlines
from tqdm import tqdm

BATCH_SIZE = 64
EPOCHS = 30
LR = 0.001
SEQ_LEN = 107
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
EPSILON = 1e-6


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_items, mode="train"):
        self.mode = mode
        self.ids = [item["id"] for item in data_items]
        self.seqs = [list(item["sequence"]) for item in data_items]
        self.structs = [list(item["structure"]) for item in data_items]
        self.loops = [list(item["predicted_loop_type"]) for item in data_items]

        if mode != "test":
            self.targets = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity"],
                        item["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        item["deg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]
            self.errors = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity_error"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]

        self.nuc_map = {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3}
        self.struct_map = {".": 0, "(": 1, ")": 2}
        self.loop_map = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        seq = torch.tensor([self.nuc_map[s] for s in self.seqs[idx]])
        struct = torch.tensor([self.struct_map[s] for s in self.structs[idx]])
        loop = torch.tensor([self.loop_map[l] for l in self.loops[idx]])
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ_LEN)

        if self.mode == "test":
            return self.ids[idx], seq, struct, loop, pos

        target = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        errors = torch.FloatTensor(self.errors[idx])
        return seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors


class MultiScaleConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.conv5 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=5, padding=2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.conv7 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(224, 128, kernel_size=7, padding=3),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.depthwise = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(384, 384, kernel_size=5, padding=2, groups=384),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(384, 256, kernel_size=1),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        c3 = self.conv3(x)
        c5 = self.conv5(x)
        c7 = self.conv7(x)
        x = torch.cat([c3, c5, c7], dim=1)
        return self.depthwise(x).permute(0, 2, 1)


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, 64)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 32)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, 32)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(SEQ_LEN, 96)

        self.conv_block = MultiScaleConv()
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            256, 512, num_layers=3, bidirectional=True, dropout=0.3, batch_first=True
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(1024, 8, 2048, dropout=0.2, activation="gelu"),
            num_layers=4,
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 5),
        )
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for name, param in self.named_parameters():
            if "weight" in name:
                if "emb" in name:
                    nn.init.normal_(param, mean=0.0, std=0.02)
                elif "conv" in name:
                    nn.init.kaiming_normal_(param, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="gelu")
                elif "lstm" in name:
                    if param.dim() >= 2:
                        nn.init.orthogonal_(param)
                elif "transformer" in name:
                    if param.dim() >= 2:
                        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(param)
            elif "bias" in name:
                nn.init.constant_(param, 0.0)

    def forward(self, seq, struct, loop, pos):
        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(seq)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        pos_emb = self.pos_emb(pos)

        x = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb, pos_emb], dim=-1)
        x = self.conv_block(x)
        x, _ = self.lstm(x)
        x = self.transformer(x.permute(1, 0, 2))
        return self.head(x.permute(1, 0, 2))


def mcrmse_loss(preds, targets, errors):
    squared_errors = (preds - targets) ** 2
    weighted_errors = squared_errors / (errors**2 + EPSILON)
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_errors, dim=[0, 1]))
    return torch.mean(rmse_per_target)


# Data loading
with jsonlines.open("input/train.jsonl") as f:
    train_data = [item for item in f if item["SN_filter"]]
train_data, val_data = train_test_split(train_data, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

train_ds = RNADataset(train_data)
val_ds = RNADataset(val_data)
test_ds = RNADataset([item for item in jsonlines.open("input/test.jsonl")], "test")

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=6, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=6, pin_memory=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=6, pin_memory=True)

# Training setup
model = RNAModel().to(DEVICE)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=0.1)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
    optimizer, max_lr=LR, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader), epochs=EPOCHS
)
best_val = float("inf")

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    progress = tqdm(train_loader, desc=f"Epoch {epoch+1}")
    for batch in progress:
        seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors = [x.to(DEVICE) for x in batch]
        pred = model(seq, struct, loop, pos)
        loss = mcrmse_loss(pred[:, :68, :3], target[:, :, :3], errors)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()
        progress.set_postfix({"loss": loss.item()})

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_loss = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors = [x.to(DEVICE) for x in batch]
            pred = model(seq, struct, loop, pos)
            val_loss.append(
                mcrmse_loss(pred[:, :68, :3], target[:, :, :3], errors).item()
            )

    avg_val = np.mean(val_loss)
    if avg_val < best_val:
        best_val = avg_val
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pt")
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val MCRMSE: {avg_val:.4f}")

# Generate submission
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
all_preds = []
all_ids = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in tqdm(test_loader, desc="Generating predictions"):
        ids, seq, struct, loop, pos = batch
        seq, struct, loop, pos = (
            seq.to(DEVICE),
            struct.to(DEVICE),
            loop.to(DEVICE),
            pos.to(DEVICE),
        )
        preds = model(seq, struct, loop, pos).cpu().numpy()

        for i in range(preds.shape[0]):
            sample_id = ids[i]
            seq_length = preds.shape[1]
            for position in range(seq_length):
                all_ids.append(f"{sample_id}_{position}")
                all_preds.append(preds[i, position])

sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
    all_preds,
    columns=["reactivity", "deg_Mg_pH10", "deg_Mg_50C", "deg_pH10", "deg_50C"],
)
sub_df.insert(0, "id_seqpos", all_ids)
sub_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Final Validation MCRMSE: {best_val:.4f}")

class RNADataset(Dataset):

        self.maps = {
            "nuc": {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3},
            "struct": {"(": 0, ")": 1, ".": 2},
            "loop": {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6},
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample = self.df.iloc[idx]
        seq = [self.maps["nuc"][c] for c in sample["sequence"]]
        struct = [self.maps["struct"][c] for c in sample["structure"]]
        loop = [self.maps["loop"][c] for c in sample["predicted_loop_type"]]

        features = (
            torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(struct, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(loop, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.arange(107, dtype=torch.long),
        )

        if self.is_test:
            return *features, sample["id"]

        targets = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        target_cols = ["reactivity", "deg_pH10", "deg_Mg_pH10", "deg_50C", "deg_Mg_50C"]
        for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
            targets[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        errors = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        error_cols = [
            "reactivity_error",
            "deg_error_pH10",
            "deg_error_Mg_pH10",
            "deg_error_50C",
            "deg_error_Mg_50C",
        ]
        for i, col in enumerate(error_cols):
            errors[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        return *features, targets, errors


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleDict(
            {
                "nuc": nn.Embedding(4, 32),
                "struct": nn.Embedding(3, 16),
                "loop": nn.Embedding(7, 24),
                "pos": nn.Embedding(107, 24),
            }
        )

        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(96, 256, 5, padding=2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(256, 512, bidirectional=True, num_layers=2, dropout=0.2)
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(1024, 8, 2048, activation="gelu", dropout=0.1),
            num_layers=4,
        )

        self.out = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 5),
        )

    def forward(self, nuc, struct, loop, pos):
        embs = [
            self.embeddings["nuc"](nuc),
            self.embeddings["struct"](struct),
            self.embeddings["loop"](loop),
            self.embeddings["pos"](pos),
        ]
        x = torch.cat(embs, dim=-1).permute(0, 2, 1)
        x = self.conv(x).permute(2, 0, 1)

        lstm_out, _ = self.lstm(x)
        x = lstm_out

        x = self.transformer(x).permute(1, 0, 2)
        return self.out(x)


def calculate_loss(preds, targets, errors):
    eps = 1e-6
    scored_preds = preds[:, :68, [0, 2, 3]]
    scored_tgts = targets[:, :, [0, 2, 3]]
    scored_errs = errors[:, :, [0, 2, 3]]
    sq_err = (scored_preds - scored_tgts) ** 2
    weighted_sq_err = sq_err / (scored_errs**2 + eps)
    mcrmse = torch.mean(torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_sq_err, dim=1)))
    return mcrmse

import torch

EPSILON = 1e-6
TARGET_WEIGHTS = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.2, 0.2]  # Weights for 5 targets


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_items, mode="train"):
        self.mode = mode
        self.ids = [item["id"] for item in data_items]
        self.seqs = [list(item["sequence"]) for item in data_items]
        self.structs = [list(item["structure"]) for item in data_items]
        self.loops = [list(item["predicted_loop_type"]) for item in data_items]

        if mode != "test":
            self.targets = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity"],
                        item["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        item["deg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]
            self.errors = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity_error"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_50C"],
                        item["deg_error_pH10"],
                        item["deg_error_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]

        self.nuc_map = {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3}
        self.struct_map = {".": 0, "(": 1, ")": 2}
        self.loop_map = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        seq = torch.tensor([self.nuc_map[s] for s in self.seqs[idx]])
        struct = torch.tensor([self.struct_map[s] for s in self.structs[idx]])
        loop = torch.tensor([self.loop_map[l] for l in self.loops[idx]])
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ_LEN)

        if self.mode == "test":
            return self.ids[idx], seq, struct, loop, pos

        target = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        errors = torch.FloatTensor(self.errors[idx])
        return seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, 32)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 16)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, 16)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(SEQ_LEN, 64)

        self.emb_norm = nn.LayerNorm(128)
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=128,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=512,
                dropout=0.1,
                activation="gelu",
                norm_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=6,
        )
        self.head = nn.Linear(128, 5)

    def forward(self, seq, struct, loop, pos):
        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(seq)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        pos_emb = self.pos_emb(pos)

        x = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb, pos_emb], dim=-1)
        x = self.emb_norm(x)
        x = self.transformer(x.permute(1, 0, 2))
        return self.head(x.permute(1, 0, 2))


def weighted_mcrmse(preds, targets, errors, weights):
    squared_errors = (preds - targets) ** 2
    weighted_errors = squared_errors / (errors**2 + EPSILON)
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_errors, dim=[0, 1]))
    return torch.sum(rmse_per_target * torch.tensor(weights, device=preds.device))

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

nuc_to_idx = {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3}
struct_to_idx = {"(": 0, ".": 1, ")": 2}
loop_type_to_idx = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}


def find_pairs(structure):
    stack = []
    pairs = {}
    for i, c in enumerate(structure):
        if c == "(":
            stack.append(i)
        elif c == ")":
            if stack:
                j = stack.pop()
                pairs[i] = j
                pairs[j] = i
    return pairs


def compute_loop_lengths(loop_type_str):
    loop_lengths = np.zeros(len(loop_type_str), dtype=np.int64)
    current_char = None
    start = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(loop_type_str):
        if c != current_char:
            if current_char is not None:
                for j in range(start, i):
                    loop_lengths[j] = i - start
            current_char = c
            start = i
    if current_char is not None:
        for j in range(start, len(loop_type_str)):
            loop_lengths[j] = len(loop_type_str) - start
    return loop_lengths


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.features_cat = []
        self.features_cont = []
        self.targets = [] if not is_test else None

        for idx in range(len(self.df)):
            row = self.df.iloc[idx]
            seq = row["sequence"]
            struct = row["structure"]
            loop_type = row["predicted_loop_type"]

            nuc_emb = np.array([nuc_to_idx[c] for c in seq], dtype=np.int64)
            struct_emb = np.array([struct_to_idx[c] for c in struct], dtype=np.int64)
            loop_emb = np.array(
                [loop_type_to_idx[c] for c in loop_type], dtype=np.int64
            )

            pairs = find_pairs(struct)
            paired = np.array(
                [1 if i in pairs else 0 for i in range(len(struct))], dtype=np.float32
            )
            paired_dist = np.array(
                [
                    abs(i - pairs[i]) / 107.0 if i in pairs else 0.0
                    for i in range(len(struct))
                ],
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            loop_lengths = compute_loop_lengths(loop_type).astype(np.float32) / 107.0

            self.features_cat.append(np.stack([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb], axis=1))
            self.features_cont.append(
                np.stack([paired, paired_dist, loop_lengths], axis=1)
            )

            if not self.is_test:
                targets = np.stack(
                    [
                        row["reactivity"],
                        row["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        row["deg_pH10"],
                        row["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        row["deg_50C"],
                    ],
                    axis=1,
                ).astype(np.float32)
                self.targets.append(targets)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        x_cat = torch.tensor(self.features_cat[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        x_cont = torch.tensor(self.features_cont[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        return (
            ((x_cat, x_cont), torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float))
            if not self.is_test
            else ((x_cat, x_cont), torch.zeros(0))
        )


class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, max_len=107):
        super().__init__()
        position = torch.arange(max_len).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = torch.exp(torch.arange(0, d_model, 2) * (-np.log(10000.0) / d_model))
        pe = torch.zeros(1, max_len, d_model)
        pe[0, :, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[0, :, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe)

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, : x.size(1)]


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64, nhead=8, num_layers=4, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, embed_dim)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, embed_dim)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, embed_dim)
        self.cont_proj = nn.Linear(3, embed_dim)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(embed_dim * 4)

        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=embed_dim * 4, nhead=nhead, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(embed_dim * 4, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 5),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x_cat, x_cont = x
        nuc = x_cat[:, :, 0]
        struct = x_cat[:, :, 1]
        loop = x_cat[:, :, 2]

        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(nuc)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        cont_emb = self.cont_proj(x_cont)

        combined = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb, cont_emb], dim=2)
        encoded = self.pos_encoder(combined)
        encoded = self.transformer(encoded)
        return self.fc(encoded)


def mcrmse_loss(pred, target):
    squared_errors = (pred - target) ** 2
    mean_squared_errors = torch.mean(squared_errors, dim=(0, 1))
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(mean_squared_errors)
    return torch.mean(rmse_per_target)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = RNAModel().to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4, weight_decay=0.01)

train_df = pd.read_json("input/train.jsonl", lines=True)
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(train_df), batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(val_df), batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

best_score = float("inf")
for epoch in range(30):
    model.train()
    for (x_cat, x_cont), y in train_loader:
        x_cat, x_cont, y = x_cat.to(device), x_cont.to(device), y.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model((x_cat, x_cont))
        preds = out[:, :68, [0, 1, 3]]
        targets = y[:, :68, [0, 1, 3]]
        loss = mcrmse_loss(preds, targets)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

    model.eval()
    val_loss = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for (x_cat, x_cont), y in val_loader:
            x_cat, x_cont, y = x_cat.to(device), x_cont.to(device), y.to(device)
            pred = model((x_cat, x_cont))[:, :68, [0, 1, 3]]
            true = y[:, :, [0, 1, 3]]
            val_loss.append(
                torch.sqrt(torch.mean((pred - true) ** 2, dim=(0, 1))).cpu().numpy()
            )

    mcrmse = np.mean(np.mean(val_loss))
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val MCRMSE: {mcrmse:.4f}")
    if mcrmse < best_score:
        best_score = mcrmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
test_df = pd.read_json("input/test.jsonl", lines=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(test_df, is_test=True), batch_size=32, num_workers=4
)

model.eval()
all_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for (x_cat, x_cont), _ in test_loader:
        x_cat, x_cont = x_cat.to(device), x_cont.to(device)
        all_preds.append(model((x_cat, x_cont)).cpu().numpy())
all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)

submission = []
for i in range(len(test_df)):
    sample_id = test_df.iloc[i]["id"]
    seq_length = len(test_df.iloc[i]["sequence"])
    for pos in range(seq_length):
        submission.append([f"{sample_id}_{pos}", *all_preds[i, pos].tolist()])

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(

        self.nuc_map = {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3}
        self.struct_map = {".": 0, "(": 1, ")": 2}
        self.loop_map = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        seq = torch.tensor([self.nuc_map[s] for s in self.seqs[idx]])
        struct = torch.tensor([self.struct_map[s] for s in self.structs[idx]])
        loop = torch.tensor([self.loop_map[l] for l in self.loops[idx]])
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ_LEN)

        if self.mode == "test":
            return self.ids[idx], seq, struct, loop, pos

        target = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        errors = torch.FloatTensor(self.errors[idx])
        return seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, 64)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 32)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, 32)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(SEQ_LEN, 64)

        self.emb_norm = nn.LayerNorm(192)

        self.conv_block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(192, 256, kernel_size=5, padding=2),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Conv1d(256, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.bilstm = nn.LSTM(
            512, 512, bidirectional=True, num_layers=2, dropout=0.3, batch_first=True
        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.2), nn.Linear(256, 5)
        )

    def forward(self, seq, struct, loop, pos):
        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(seq)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        pos_emb = self.pos_emb(pos)

        x = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb, pos_emb], dim=-1)
        x = self.emb_norm(x)

        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)  # [batch, channels, seq_len]
        x = self.conv_block(x)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)  # [batch, seq_len, features]

        x, _ = self.bilstm(x)
        return self.head(x)


def weighted_mcrmse(preds, targets, errors, weights):
    squared_errors = (preds - targets) ** 2
    weighted_errors = squared_errors / (errors**2 + EPSILON)
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_errors, dim=[0, 1]))
    return torch.sum(rmse_per_target * torch.tensor(weights, device=preds.device))

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

nuc_to_idx = {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3}
struct_to_idx = {"(": 0, ".": 1, ")": 2}
loop_type_to_idx = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}


def find_pairs(structure):
    stack = []
    pairs = {}
    for i, c in enumerate(structure):
        if c == "(":
            stack.append(i)
        elif c == ")":
            if stack:
                j = stack.pop()
                pairs[i] = j
                pairs[j] = i
    return pairs


def compute_loop_lengths(loop_type_str):
    loop_lengths = np.zeros(len(loop_type_str), dtype=np.int64)
    current_char = None
    start = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(loop_type_str):
        if c != current_char:
            if current_char is not None:
                for j in range(start, i):
                    loop_lengths[j] = i - start
            current_char = c
            start = i
    if current_char is not None:
        for j in range(start, len(loop_type_str)):
            loop_lengths[j] = len(loop_type_str) - start
    return loop_lengths


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.features_cat = []
        self.features_cont = []
        self.targets = [] if not is_test else None

        for idx in range(len(self.df)):
            row = self.df.iloc[idx]
            seq = row["sequence"]
            struct = row["structure"]
            loop_type = row["predicted_loop_type"]

            nuc_emb = np.array([nuc_to_idx[c] for c in seq], dtype=np.int64)
            struct_emb = np.array([struct_to_idx[c] for c in struct], dtype=np.int64)
            loop_emb = np.array(
                [loop_type_to_idx[c] for c in loop_type], dtype=np.int64
            )

            pairs = find_pairs(struct)
            paired = np.array(
                [1 if i in pairs else 0 for i in range(len(struct))], dtype=np.float32
            )
            paired_dist = np.array(
                [
                    abs(i - pairs[i]) / 107.0 if i in pairs else 0.0
                    for i in range(len(struct))
                ],
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            loop_lengths = compute_loop_lengths(loop_type).astype(np.float32) / 107.0

            self.features_cat.append(np.stack([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb], axis=1))
            self.features_cont.append(
                np.stack([paired, paired_dist, loop_lengths], axis=1)
            )

            if not self.is_test:
                targets = np.stack(
                    [
                        row["reactivity"],
                        row["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        row["deg_pH10"],
                        row["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        row["deg_50C"],
                    ],
                    axis=1,
                ).astype(np.float32)
                self.targets.append(targets)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        x_cat = torch.tensor(self.features_cat[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        x_cont = torch.tensor(self.features_cont[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        return (
            ((x_cat, x_cont), torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float))
            if not self.is_test
            else ((x_cat, x_cont), torch.zeros(0))
        )


class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, max_len=107):
        super().__init__()
        position = torch.arange(max_len).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = torch.exp(torch.arange(0, d_model, 2) * (-np.log(10000.0) / d_model))
        pe = torch.zeros(1, max_len, d_model)
        pe[0, :, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[0, :, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe)

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, : x.size(1)]


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64, nhead=8, num_layers=4, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, embed_dim)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, embed_dim)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, embed_dim)
        self.cont_proj = nn.Linear(3, embed_dim)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(embed_dim * 4)

        # Transformer branch
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=embed_dim * 4, nhead=nhead, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers)

        # CNN branch for local patterns
        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(embed_dim * 4, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Final prediction head
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(embed_dim * 4 + 128, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 5),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x_cat, x_cont = x
        nuc, struct, loop = x_cat[:, :, 0], x_cat[:, :, 1], x_cat[:, :, 2]

        # Embedding layers
        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(nuc)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        cont_emb = self.cont_proj(x_cont)

        combined = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb, cont_emb], dim=2)
        encoded = self.pos_encoder(combined)

        # Transformer pathway
        transformer_out = self.transformer(encoded)

        # CNN pathway
        cnn_out = self.cnn(encoded.permute(0, 2, 1)).permute(0, 2, 1)

        # Combine features
        combined_features = torch.cat([transformer_out, cnn_out], dim=2)

        return self.fc(combined_features)


def mcrmse_loss(pred, target):
    squared_errors = (pred - target) ** 2
    mean_squared_errors = torch.mean(squared_errors, dim=(0, 1))
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(mean_squared_errors)
    return torch.mean(rmse_per_target)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = RNAModel(embed_dim=128, nhead=8, num_layers=6).to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4, weight_decay=0.01)

train_df = pd.read_json("input/train.jsonl", lines=True)
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(train_df), batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(val_df), batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

best_score = float("inf")
for epoch in range(40):
    model.train()
    for (x_cat, x_cont), y in train_loader:
        x_cat, x_cont, y = x_cat.to(device), x_cont.to(device), y.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model((x_cat, x_cont))
        preds = out[:, :68, [0, 1, 3]]
        targets = y[:, :68, [0, 1, 3]]
        loss = mcrmse_loss(preds, targets)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

    model.eval()
    val_loss = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for (x_cat, x_cont), y in val_loader:
            x_cat, x_cont, y = x_cat.to(device), x_cont.to(device), y.to(device)
            pred = model((x_cat, x_cont))[:, :68, [0, 1, 3]]
            true = y[:, :, [0, 1, 3]]
            val_loss.append(
                torch.sqrt(torch.mean((pred - true) ** 2, dim=(0, 1))).cpu().numpy()
            )

    mcrmse = np.mean(np.mean(val_loss))
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val MCRMSE: {mcrmse:.4f}")
    if mcrmse < best_score:
        best_score = mcrmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
test_df = pd.read_json("input/test.jsonl", lines=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(test_df, is_test=True), batch_size=32, num_workers=4
)

model.eval()
all_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for (x_cat, x_cont), _ in test_loader:
        x_cat, x_cont = x_cat.to(device), x_cont.to(device)
        all_preds.append(model((x_cat, x_cont)).cpu().numpy())
all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)

submission = []
for i in range(len(test_df)):
    sample_id = test_df.iloc[i]["id"]
    seq_length = len(test_df.iloc[i]["sequence"])
    for pos in range(seq_length):
        submission.append([f"{sample_id}_{pos}", *all_preds[i, pos].tolist()])

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(

)

import os

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split


def read_jsonl(path):
    return pd.DataFrame([json.loads(line) for line in open(path)])


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.maps = {
            "nuc": {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3},
            "struct": {"(": 0, ")": 1, ".": 2},
            "loop": {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6},
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample = self.df.iloc[idx]
        seq = [self.maps["nuc"][c] for c in sample["sequence"]]
        struct = [self.maps["struct"][c] for c in sample["structure"]]
        loop = [self.maps["loop"][c] for c in sample["predicted_loop_type"]]

        features = (
            torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(struct, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(loop, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.arange(107, dtype=torch.long),
        )

        if self.is_test:
            return *features, sample["id"]

        targets = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        target_cols = ["reactivity", "deg_pH10", "deg_Mg_pH10", "deg_50C", "deg_Mg_50C"]
        for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
            targets[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        errors = torch.zeros(68, 5, dtype=torch.float32)
        error_cols = [
            "reactivity_error",
            "deg_error_pH10",
            "deg_error_Mg_pH10",
            "deg_error_50C",
            "deg_error_Mg_50C",
        ]
        for i, col in enumerate(error_cols):
            errors[:, i] = torch.tensor(sample[col])

        return *features, targets, errors


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleDict(
            {
                "nuc": nn.Embedding(4, 32),
                "struct": nn.Embedding(3, 16),
                "loop": nn.Embedding(7, 24),
                "pos": nn.Embedding(107, 24),
            }
        )

        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(96, 256, 5, padding=2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(256, 512, bidirectional=True, num_layers=2, dropout=0.2)
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(1024, 8, 2048, activation="gelu", dropout=0.1),
            num_layers=4,
        )

        self.out = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 5),
        )

    def forward(self, nuc, struct, loop, pos):
        embs = [
            self.embeddings["nuc"](nuc),
            self.embeddings["struct"](struct),
            self.embeddings["loop"](loop),
            self.embeddings["pos"](pos),
        ]
        x = torch.cat(embs, dim=-1).permute(0, 2, 1)
        x = self.conv(x).permute(2, 0, 1)

        lstm_out, _ = self.lstm(x)
        x = lstm_out

        x = self.transformer(x).permute(1, 0, 2)
        return self.out(x)


def calculate_loss(preds, targets, errors):
    eps = 1e-6
    # Correct indices for scored targets: reactivity(0), deg_Mg_pH10(2), deg_Mg_50C(4)
    scored_preds = preds[:, :68, [0, 2, 4]]
    scored_tgts = targets[:, :, [0, 2, 4]]
    scored_errs = errors[:, :, [0, 2, 4]]
    sq_err = (scored_preds - scored_tgts) ** 2
    weighted_sq_err = sq_err / (scored_errs**2 + eps)
    mcrmse = torch.mean(torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_sq_err, dim=1)))
    return mcrmse


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
train_df = read_jsonl("input/train.jsonl")
train_data, val_data = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    RNADataset(val_data), batch_size=128, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
)

model = RNAModel().to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=0.05)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
    optimizer, max_lr=1e-3, epochs=10, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader)
)

best_val = float("inf")
for epoch in range(10):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        nuc, struct, loop, pos, tgt, errs = [x.to(device) for x in batch]
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        preds = model(nuc, struct, loop, pos)
        loss = calculate_loss(preds, tgt, errs)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * nuc.size(0)

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            nuc, struct, loop, pos, tgt, errs = [x.to(device) for x in batch]
            preds = model(nuc, struct, loop, pos)
            val_loss += calculate_loss(preds, tgt, errs).item() * nuc.size(0)

    train_loss /= len(train_data)
    val_loss /= len(val_data)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Train {train_loss:.4f} | Val {val_loss:.4f}")

    if val_loss < best_val:
        best_val = val_loss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

# Generate submission
test_df = read_jsonl("input/test.jsonl")
test_loader = DataLoader(

import torch

BATCH_SIZE = 32
EPOCHS = 50
LR = 0.0005
SEQ_LEN = 107
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
EPSILON = 1e-6
TARGET_WEIGHTS = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.2, 0.2]
NHEAD = 8
NUM_ENCODER_LAYERS = 3
DIM_FEEDFORWARD = 1024


class RNADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_items, mode="train"):
        self.mode = mode
        self.ids = [item["id"] for item in data_items]
        self.seqs = [list(item["sequence"]) for item in data_items]
        self.structs = [list(item["structure"]) for item in data_items]
        self.loops = [list(item["predicted_loop_type"]) for item in data_items]

        if mode != "test":
            self.targets = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity"],
                        item["deg_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_Mg_50C"],
                        item["deg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]
            self.errors = [
                np.vstack(
                    [
                        item["reactivity_error"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_pH10"],
                        item["deg_error_Mg_50C"],
                        item["deg_error_pH10"],
                        item["deg_error_50C"],
                    ]
                ).T
                for item in data_items
            ]

        self.nuc_map = {"A": 0, "G": 1, "U": 2, "C": 3}
        self.struct_map = {".": 0, "(": 1, ")": 2}
        self.loop_map = {"S": 0, "M": 1, "I": 2, "B": 3, "H": 4, "E": 5, "X": 6}

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        seq = torch.tensor([self.nuc_map[s] for s in self.seqs[idx]])
        struct = torch.tensor([self.struct_map[s] for s in self.structs[idx]])
        loop = torch.tensor([self.loop_map[l] for l in self.loops[idx]])
        pos = torch.arange(SEQ_LEN)

        if self.mode == "test":
            return self.ids[idx], seq, struct, loop, pos

        target = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        errors = torch.FloatTensor(self.errors[idx])
        return seq, struct, loop, pos, target, errors


class RNAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.nuc_emb = nn.Embedding(4, 64)
        self.struct_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 32)
        self.loop_emb = nn.Embedding(7, 32)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(SEQ_LEN, 64)

        self.emb_norm = nn.LayerNorm(192)

        self.conv_block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(192, 256, kernel_size=5, padding=2),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Conv1d(256, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        encoder_layers = TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=512,
            nhead=NHEAD,
            dim_feedforward=DIM_FEEDFORWARD,
            dropout=0.3,
            activation="gelu",
        )
        self.transformer_encoder = TransformerEncoder(
            encoder_layers, NUM_ENCODER_LAYERS
        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.2), nn.Linear(256, 5)
        )

    def forward(self, seq, struct, loop, pos):
        nuc_emb = self.nuc_emb(seq)
        struct_emb = self.struct_emb(struct)
        loop_emb = self.loop_emb(loop)
        pos_emb = self.pos_emb(pos)

        x = torch.cat([nuc_emb, struct_emb, loop_emb, pos_emb], dim=-1)
        x = self.emb_norm(x)

        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        x = self.conv_block(x)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)

        x = x.permute(1, 0, 2)  # [seq_len, batch, features]
        x = self.transformer_encoder(x)
        x = x.permute(1, 0, 2)  # [batch, seq_len, features]

        return self.head(x)


def weighted_mcrmse(preds, targets, errors, weights):
    squared_errors = (preds - targets) ** 2
    weighted_errors = squared_errors / (errors**2 + EPSILON)
    rmse_per_target = torch.sqrt(torch.mean(weighted_errors, dim=[0, 1]))
    return torch.sum(rmse_per_target * torch.tensor(weights, device=preds.device))

import os
